title: Heterogeneous biased Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let each coordinate parameter $p_i$ lie in $(0,1)$, let $f$ be a real-valued function on sign vectors of length $n$, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates. The heterogeneous biased Fourier coefficient indexed by $S$ is the expectation, under the product distribution with coordinate parameters $p_i$, of $f(x)$ times the heterogeneous biased monomial indexed by $S$, evaluated at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Each coordinate parameter $p_i$ lies strictly between $0$ and $1$
$f$ is a real-valued function on sign vectors of length $n$
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definitions of the one-coordinate biased sign distribution or standardized biased sign.
